regions.region: upper-left title, authors, abstract, and lower-left article/SI note
regions.finding: Article title, authors, DOI context, and an explicit statement that Supporting Information is available; no SI file was supplied or associated.
Six cited prior-work reaction panels, retained as literature_example records rather than present-paper experiments.
Current-work generic copper-catalyzed gamma-protoborylation/protosilylation design; no experiment-specific yield assigned.

unresolved: The cited prior-work panels were not expanded into complete molecule registries or experimental procedures.
Supporting Information is mentioned but was not supplied; no SI association was inferred.

regions.region: left lower half, Table 1 main grid
regions.finding: All 18 optimization rows were read individually, including catalyst loading, reagent/tBuOH equivalents, temperature, NMR yield, isolated values in parentheses, and N.R./0-yield controls.

regions.region: below Table 1, ligand drawings and footnotes a-i
regions.finding: PPh3 and L1-L3 additions, entry-14 KOtBu 23 mol%, no-base entry 12, 12 h silylation exception, NMR basis, and isolated-yield footnote were structured.

regions.region: both text columns above/right of Table 1
regions.finding: Optimization discussion and Table 2 scope narrative were used as supporting context; repeated mentions were not counted as extra experiments.

unresolved: No product detection limit is reported for entries 11-12 (N.R.) or entry 16 (0% yield).
Complete structures/stereochemical assignments of ligands L1-L3 were not encoded from the dense drawings.

regions.region: left upper half, Table 2 products and footnotes
regions.finding: Eighteen scope products were inventoried. 4a and 5a match Table 1 entries 9 and 18 and were linked as repeated evidence; the other 16 are separate scope experiments. Product-specific time, temperature, Cu loading, reagent, yield, and dr footnotes were retained.

regions.region: left lower half, Table 3 equations and three diboron drawings
regions.finding: Three independent diboron/oxidation experiments were recorded, with alcohol 8 yields 71%, 43%, and 55%; unstable intermediate 7 was not misrepresented as a separately isolated synthesis.
Two gram-scale reactions and three derivatization experiments were recorded; low-temperature stages, timed holds, warming, reagent equivalents, product yields, Z/E and dr results were separated.

regions.region: right upper text and mechanism discussion beginning
regions.finding: Scale-up/derivatization prose supports Scheme 2. The following catalytic-cycle discussion is author interpretation, not a new mechanistic experiment.

unresolved: Yield measurement basis is not stated for most Table 2/Table 3/ Scheme 2 outcomes; null/missing is preserved rather than assuming isolated yield.
Complex dense scope structures retain labels and image evidence where a complete stereochemically faithful SMILES could not be safely transcribed.
Table 3 does not assign a specific CuI loading within 5-10 mol% to each reagent and does not report oxidation time.
Scheme 2 eq. 3 prints 2 h for the -78 °C-to-room-temperature program without separately assigning ramp and hold times; eq. 5 gives no time for the final warming stage.

regions.finding: Author-proposed Cu-Y catalytic cycle with intermediates I-III; stored as proposed_mechanism, not as an observed mechanistic experiment.
Mechanistic rationale, conclusion, acknowledgements, conflict statement, keywords, and references; no new synthesis experiment identified.

unresolved: The proposed intermediates and LUMO-based regioselectivity explanation are not direct experimental proof in the supplied pages.

regions.finding: References 11-22 and manuscript received/revised/accepted dates only; no reaction arrow, table row, present-paper synthesis, or standalone characterization table was identified.
